items.source: The context in which the AOT processing happens.
items.translation: AOT 处理发生的上下文。

items.source:
Configuration object that captures various AOT configuration aspects of types within the data context by offering
predefined methods to register native configuration necessary for data binding, projection proxy definitions, AOT
cglib bytecode generation and other common tasks.
items.translation: 一个配置对象，通过提供预定义方法来注册数据绑定所需的本机配置、投影代理定义、AOT cglib 字节码生成以及其他常见任务，从而捕获数据上下文中类型的各种 AOT 配置方面。

items.translation: 用于创建AotContext实例的构建器。

items.source:
Support for registering the need for reflection, resources, java serialization and proxies at runtime for Ahead of
Time compilation.
items.translation: 支持在运行时注册对反射、资源、Java 序列化及代理的需求，以用于提前编译（Ahead of Time Compilation）。

items.source: Support classes for repository namespace and JavaConfig integration.
items.translation: 支持仓库命名空间与 JavaConfig 集成的辅助类。
